values.note: No nightly rate is posted on the village page or its guide; Firefly shows rates only behind its reCAPTCHA search. 'Each reservation incurs a $6.00 reservation processing fee' plus possible credit-card fees; an optional $10 'lock-in' guarantees the chosen site. Dock space for registered campers $10 a day, up to 2 weeks.

fees.source: Thurston Park Family Campground Guide, linked from https://centrallakemi.org/thurston-park/ ('Each reservation incurs a $6.00 reservation processing fee', 'A "lock-in" feature is available for an additional $10 fee', 'Dock Rentals ... $10 per day, maximum 2 weeks'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Full hookups at bluff sites 27-32 and upper sites 36-40 (most of them held by seasonal campers); water and electric at 33-35; electric with water for tank fill only at the waterfront sites 1-7, 9, 10 and standard sites 11-26.

hookups.source: Thurston Park Family Campground Guide, 'CampSites/Amenities/Rates/Restrictions' ('Premium Bluff Sites, 27-32 Full Hook-up (electric/water/sewer)', 'Upper-Level Sites, 36-40 Full hook-up', 'Upper-Level Sites, 33-35 Water and Electric hook-up', 'Waterfront Sites, 1-7, 9, 10 Electric hook-up Water available for fill', 'Standard Sites, 11-26 Electric hook-up Water available for fill') + Seasonal/Annual Camper Policy, read 2026-10-25

values.note: Sites 1-40: waterfront 1-7, 9, 10; standard 11-26; bluff 27-32 (view of Intermediate Lake); upper 33-40; site 8 is tent-only. Seasonal campers hold 27-30, 32, 36, 37 and 40, an annual camper 31 (9 of 39 RV sites). Extended stays of 30+ days allowed except on the waterfront sites.

sites.source: Thurston Park Family Campground Guide + Thurston Park Seasonal/Annual Camper Policy (created 10/1/24: 'Seasonal bluff sites include site(s): Upper Campground 27-30,32', 'Seasonal non-bluff includes site(s): Upper Campground 36,37,40', 'Annual site(s): Upper Campground 31'), read 2026-10-25

facilities.source: https://centrallakemi.org/thurston-park/ ('Restrooms and Showers', 'Dump Station', 'Thurston Park Campground also has free WiFi for our campers'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: The first Friday in May to the first Sunday in October.

season.source: https://centrallakemi.org/thurston-park/ ('Our camping season spans from the first Friday in May to the first Sunday in October') + the Guide ('The park opens the first Friday in May and closes the first Sunday in October'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Booked on the village's Firefly page; the campground manager (Char & Ron Snay, 231-676-8539, on site 7 days a week in season) handles reservations. The next year's sites open in January: the village page says the 2nd Tuesday at 8am (January 13, 2026), the guide says the second Monday. The waterfront sites (1-7, 9, 10) take 4 nights on weekends and 14 nights at most. Seasonal sites by the village clerk's waiting list. Check-in 3-10 pm; late arrivals must call the manager. Check-out noon.

booking.source: https://centrallakemi.org/thurston-park/ ('Our reservation portal will open the 2nd Tuesday of January ... at 8am', camp host phone) + the Guide ('On the second Monday in January, sites become available', 'Four (4) night minimum stay on weekends', 'Fourteen (14) night maximum stay', check-in/out) + Seasonal/Annual Camper Policy, read 2026-10-25

note: Village of Central Lake park at the northwest end of Intermediate Lake (Antrim County Chain of Lakes), 7854 Bradford St. Boat launch, public docks, gazebo, playground, fish-cleaning station; easy walk to downtown. --Claude
summary: Village page + its Campground Guide and Seasonal/Annual Policy (Adobe-hosted docs, read in the browser): confirmed water/sewer (full hookups at 27-32 and 36-40), showers, dump, reservable on Firefly; added 40 sites with the site plan, $6 reservation fee, Wi-Fi, season (first Friday in May - first Sunday in October), the waterfront sites' 4-night weekend minimum and 14-night cap, January opening of bookings. No nightly rate is posted anywhere outside Firefly's captcha (public park, no price requirement). Seasonal share 9 of 39 RV sites; passes test 4. Note trimmed of hookups, season and booking.
flags: Waterfront sites 1-7, 9, 10 carry a 4-night weekend minimum (and 14-night maximum) per the village's Campground Guide; recorded in booking.note rather than min_stay because it binds only those 9 sites. The other ~21 nightly sites have no stated minimum.
